description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git rev-list' with missing objects. It sets up git repositories, manipulates objects to be missing, and verifies the output of rev-list commands under various conditions related to missing objects.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts an object id to a file system path within the .git directory.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files to ensure they are identical.
